plain: This story is about a rock from Mars that landed on Earth. According to a podcast host named Jesse Michels, scientists found a Martian meteorite in Antarctica in 1984 and gave it the code name ALH84001. The story goes that the rock seemed to hold tiny shapes that might be fossilised bacteria. That matters because, if true, it would mean there was once life on Mars. Michels says President Bill Clinton gave a speech about it in the 1990s. A scientist guest, Dr. John Brandenburg, also tells of the find in Antarctica, though he places it in the 1990s. In a later episode Michels brings it up again, this time focusing on Clinton's speech rather than the discovery. So it is told by the host twice and by a scientist, with some difference over the date.
